chunks: So leave with your family late in the night, yourself remaining in the rear, and let none turn back to look, and go where you will be commanded.

key_terms.بِقِطْعٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ: In a portion/part of the night

ai.seo_question: What were the specific instructions given to Prophet Muhammad during the night of Hijrah?
ai.summary: While traditionally associated with the Hijrah, Shia exegetes often interpret this verse as addressing Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) specifically, highlighting the centrality of the Ahl al-Bayt in the divine plan of salvation. The command to 'not let anyone look back' is viewed as a lesson in unwavering commitment to divine will, emphasizing that the family of the Prophet must remain united and focused on their mission without distraction.
